description: Enacted and signed state legislation, one file per state. Federal laws, executive orders, and amendments stay in their own files.

AK.name: Alaska
AK.note: Chaptered or signed bills on Alaska Legislature BASIS bill-range pages for the 32nd, 33rd, and 34th legislatures.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.note: Chapters published on the Massachusetts General Court session-law acts pages.

MN.name: Minnesota
MN.note: Chapters on the Minnesota Revisor session-law index. The date is the presentment date printed in that table. The index does not print a separate subject title; the row is named by chapter and bill number.

OR.name: Oregon
OR.note: Measures the Oregon Legislative Information System marks Chapter Number Assigned since 2023, excluding vetoed measures and the placeholder chapter 9999.

TX.name: Texas
TX.note: Bills on the Texas Legislature report titled Bills Signed by the Governor, for the 87th, 88th, and 89th regular sessions. The date is the last-action date printed on that report.

WA.name: Washington
WA.note: Bills the Washington Legislative Web Service lists as signed by the governor for the 2023-24 and 2025-26 biennia, with the session-law title and effective date. Full vetoes are omitted.

WI.name: Wisconsin
WI.note: Acts listed on the Wisconsin Legislative Reference Bureau acts index. The index states the relating-to clause and does not state an approval date.

WY.name: Wyoming
WY.note: Wyoming Legislature bill records for 2023–2026 with a signature date, a governor-signed action, or a chapter number.
